Job Description
Insight Global is seeking a Data Analyst to support a client’s Culinary Co-Pilot product, an AI-enabled capability focused on improving how food service and menu solutions are planned, managed, and optimized.
This individual will be responsible for taking large, complex datasets and translating them into clear business insights and actionable narratives. The ideal candidate combines strong analytical skills with business and financial acumen. They should be comfortable digging into data, identifying trends and correlations, and explaining what those findings mean to business stakeholders.
For example, this person may analyze the financial performance of an account, identify areas where performance is struggling, correlate those results with food service or product effectiveness, and determine where technology or product solutions could have a measurable impact.
This is not primarily a Power BI development role. The emphasis is on someone who can work directly with data, analyze it in tools such as Excel, and ultimately tell the story behind the numbers.
Key Responsibilities
Analyze large and complex datasets to identify trends, patterns, correlations, and opportunities.
Evaluate financial and operational performance data and translate findings into meaningful business insights.
Use Excel, including pivot tables and other advanced analytical functions, to manipulate, organize, and analyze data.
Connect product usage and performance data to broader financial and business outcomes.
Develop clear narratives that explain what the data is showing, why it matters, and what actions the business could take as a result.
Help quantify and demonstrate the ROI and effectiveness of product and technology solutions, including Culinary Co-Pilot.
Identify underperforming accounts or business areas and break down the data to understand potential drivers.
Partner with product, operations, culinary, finance, and technology stakeholders to understand business questions and determine the data needed to answer them.
Surface opportunities where product capabilities or technology solutions could potentially improve financial or operational performance.
Prepare analyses and insights that can be easily understood by both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Support ongoing measurement of product performance, adoption, and business impact.
Skills and Requirements
5+ years of experience in Data Analytics, Business Analytics, Financial Analytics, Business Analysis, or a related analytical role.
Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including pivot tables, data manipulation, and analysis of large datasets.
Demonstrated experience working with large and/or complex datasets.
Experience analyzing financial, operational, or business performance data.
Strong analytical and critical-thinking skills with the ability to move beyond reporting numbers and identify what is driving the results.
Proven ability to translate complex data into clear, compelling business narratives and recommendations.
Strong business acumen and the ability to connect data findings to financial and operational outcomes.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills with experience presenting findings to business stakeholders.
Ability to work independently and take an ambiguous business question from initial analysis through a clear conclusion or recommendation.
Experience supporting product analytics, ROI analysis, financial analysis, or technology-enabled business solutions.
Experience analyzing product effectiveness, customer/account performance, or operational performance.
Experience with Power BI or similar visualization/reporting tools.
Familiarity with SQL, Snowflake, or other data platforms.
Exposure to AI-enabled or analytics-driven products.
Food service, hospitality, culinary, retail, or consumer-focused industry experience is a plus, but not required.

You will be a valued member of the Data & Analytics team and work collaboratively with business stakeholders, data engineers, and technology partners to deliver advanced analytics solutions that improve business outcomes, operational efficiency, and customer experiences.

+ Strong expertise in Snowflake SQL, query optimization, and analytical data modeling.
+ Experience performing exploratory data analysis, trend analysis, statistical analysis, and business performance assessments.
+ Hands-on experience developing analytical datasets, reports, dashboards, and business intelligence solutions.
+ Experience working with structured and semi-structured data in cloud-based analytics environments.
+ Strong understanding of data quality, reconciliation, validation, and governance practices.
+ Experience collaborating with business stakeholders to gather requirements and deliver data-driven recommendations.
+ Excellent analytical, problem-solving, communication, and presentation skills.
+ Ability to work independently in a distributed team environment while managing multiple priorities.

Job Description
The Perelman School of Medicine at the University of Pennsylvania invites applications for a Data Analyst position focused on multimodal biomedical data processing, integration, quality assurance, and analysis within large-scale translational research studies. The position involves working with complex datasets spanning neuroimaging, electrophysiology, autonomics, behavioral assessments, biospecimens, clinical measures, and other high-dimensional biomedical data streams.
The successful candidate will contribute to the development and implementation of data workflows, harmonization strategies, quality control procedures, visualization tools, and analytical pipelines that support multimodal phenotyping and precision health research. This role is ideal for individuals interested in biomedical data science, translational medicine, computational neuroscience, or integrative analytics in complex human studies. Position contingent upon funding.
This is an on-site position based at the University of Pennsylvania.
Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States.
Lab / Program Description The research environment is centered around the development of quantitative and computational approaches for multimodal biomedical data analysis in clinically relevant populations. Ongoing efforts involve integration of imaging, physiology, electrophysiology, behavioral, and biospecimen-derived data to better understand variability in human health, disease, injury, and recovery.
Research activities include development of scalable data processing pipelines, automated quality assurance frameworks, multimodal data harmonization approaches, statistical and machine learning methodologies, and translational tools that facilitate clinically meaningful interpretation of complex biomedical datasets.
Key Responsibilities
+ Perform processing, organization, harmonization, and quality control of multimodal biomedical datasets, including imaging, electrophysiology, physiological, behavioral, clinical, and biospecimen-related data.
+ Develop and maintain computational workflows and analytical pipelines using programming languages such as Python, and R.
+ Conduct statistical analyses and data visualization to extract meaningful insights from high-dimensional and longitudinal datasets.
+ Assist with multimodal data integration, database management, and data standardization across research studies.
+ Collaborate with interdisciplinary teams including clinicians, engineers, data scientists, and research coordinators.
+ Contribute to preparation of figures, reports, presentations, and manuscripts for scientific dissemination.
+ Support development of reproducible and scalable research infrastructure for translational biomedical studies.
Qualifications
+ Bachelor’s degree in Biomedical Engineering, Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, Neuroscience, Mathematics, Bioinformatics, or related quantitative fields, and 2-3 years of experience or an equivalent combination of education and experience required.
+ Strong programming experience in Python, R, or related computational environments.
+ Experience working with complex biomedical or scientific datasets.
+ Familiarity with statistical analysis methods and data visualization techniques.
+ Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail.
+ Strong written and verbal communication skills.
